_doc: Local kind validation of the pool write client + fleet coordination: disjoint per-pod slices of a global key domain, plain appends, setup-before-barrier. Small ladder exercises the walker, barrier, window alignment and hdr-merge end to end; after the run, `ds-bench verify-offsets` compares server-side stream offsets against the fleet's client-observed totals (see scripts/verify-write-accuracy.sh).
